articles.title: Day 26 | Information Technology Act: The Law Behind India’s Fight Against Cybercrime
articles.summary: The Information Technology Act, 2000, came into force on 17 October 2000. It provides legal recognition for electronic records and electronic transactions, supports electronic governance, and establishes provisions addressing specified offences and contraventions involving computer resources. The Act was subsequently amended, including through the Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008, which introduced or revised several provisions relevant to modern cybercrime.

articles.title: EAAA India Alternatives IPO: ₹1,200-crore issue opens for subscription today
articles.summary: The ₹1,200-crore initial public offering (IPO) of EAAA India Alternatives Ltd. , an alternative investment platform backed by Edelweiss Financial Services, opens for subscription on Monday, October 26. The issue will close on October 28. The company has set a price band of ₹1,585–₹1,665 per share, valuing it at ₹10,765 crore at the upper end of the band.
articles.title_hi: EAAA इंडिया अल्टरनेटिव्स IPO: ₹1,200 करोड़ का इश्यू आज सब्सक्रिप्शन के लिए खुला
articles.summary_hi: एडलवाइस फाइनेंशियल सर्विसेज द्वारा समर्थित एक वैकल्पिक निवेश मंच, ईएए इंडिया अल्टरनेटिव्स लिमिटेड की ₹1,200 करोड़ की आरंभिक सार्वजनिक पेशकश (आईपीओ) सोमवार, 26 अक्टूबर को सदस्यता के लिए खुलती है। यह मुद्दा 28 अक्टूबर को बंद हो जाएगा। कंपनी ने प्रति शेयर ₹1,585-₹1,665 का मूल्य बैंड निर्धारित किया है, बैंड के ऊपरी छोर पर इसका मूल्य ₹10,765 करोड़ है।
articles.title_hinglish: EAAA indiya altaranetivsa IPO: ₹1,200 karoda ka ishyu aaja sabsakripshana ke lie khula
articles.summary_hinglish: edalavaisa phainenshiyala sarviseja dvara samarthita eka vaikalpika nivesha manch, eeee indiya altaranetivsa limiteda ki ₹1,200 karoda ki aaranbhika sarvajanika peshakasha (aaeepio) somavar, 26 aktubara ko sadasyata ke lie khulati hai। yaha mudda 28 aktubara ko banda ho jaega। kanpani ne prati sheyara ₹1,585-₹1,665 ka mulya bainda nirdharita kiya hai, bainda ke oopari chhora para isaka mulya ₹10,765 karoda hai।

articles.title: TVK govt may not last 6 months: M K Stalin
articles.summary: CHENNAI: DMK president and former chief minister M K Stalin on Sunday alleged that the law and order situation in the state was deteriorating, with rising incidents of violence, drug trafficking, and crimes against women and children. He also said that the TVK-led government might not even last six months.

articles.title: IMD weather today: ‘Red’ alert for heavy rains in Odisha, Kerala, Tamil Nadu
articles.summary: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a red alert for extremely heavy rainfall across several districts in Odisha and Kerala, while torrential downpours continue to disrupt normal life in Tamil Nadu. With severe waterlogging, localised flooding, and emergency rescues already underway in the southern states, authorities are bracing for further impact over the coming days.

articles.title: Indian cartoonists face Instagram blocks amid growing political satire censorship
articles.summary: Indian cartoonists Satish Acharya and Manjul found their Instagram accounts restricted in India without explanation this week. Meta platforms used legal information technology orders to limit their political satire. Critics warn that such censorship threatens free speech and a long tradition of democratic dissent in India, while the government defends the rules as necessary to manage unlawful online material.

articles.summary: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was detained by police in Gurugram on October 10 after joining Cockroach Janta Party protests in Bengaluru. The movement demands the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral roll irregularities. Rathee shifted from online commentary to street activism, while political leaders like Rahul Gandhi publicly backed the demonstrations.

articles.title: Kerala Blasters' takeover and Inter Kashi's wage row show money pressures on ISL teams

articles.title: PM Modi to visit Uttar Pradesh and Odisha on October 25

articles.title: Death of Indian Tech Journalism: How the ₹3 Lakh iPhone Duo Exposed Influencer Access
articles.summary: Mainstream Indian tech channels responded with unboxing theatricals, “camera mast hai” monologues, and lifestyle flexes. Trapped between leaked ₹26 Lakh PR agency payouts and fear of brand blacklisting, Indian tech YouTube has abandoned technical engineering journalism. The gap between global tech journalism and Indian tech content creation has reached an unsustainable breaking point.

articles.title: Ind AS 118: India Inc gears up for big changes to financial reporting
articles.summary: Indias largest companies are preparing for the implementation of Ind AS 118, which may impact financial reporting. Changes include new classifications for income and expenses, and new operating profit reporting methods. Companies face challenges due to complex requirements and the need for system adjustments. Audit committees are discussing transition plans while awaiting final rules and guidance from regulatory bodies.

articles.title: Indian victim compensation scheme faces severe delays and payout gaps
articles.summary: A new study reveals that India's victim compensation scheme is struggling with rising backlogs and procedural delays, leaving pending cases at 33,257 during the 2023 to 2024 period. The research highlights significant state-wise payout gaps across the country. These administrative bottlenecks hinder justice for victims, prompting concerns about the efficiency of the current support framework moving forward.
articles.title_hi: भारतीय पीड़ित मुआवजा योजना को गंभीर देरी और भुगतान अंतराल का सामना करना पड़ता है
articles.summary_hi: एक नए अध्ययन से पता चलता है कि भारत की पीड़ित मुआवजा योजना बढ़ते बैकलॉग और प्रक्रियात्मक देरी से जूझ रही है, जिससे 2023 से 2024 की अवधि के दौरान 33,257 मामले लंबित रह गए हैं। यह शोध देश भर में महत्वपूर्ण राज्य-वार भुगतान अंतराल पर प्रकाश डालता है। ये प्रशासनिक बाधाएँ पीड़ितों को न्याय दिलाने में बाधा डालती हैं, जिससे वर्तमान सहायता ढाँचे की आगे बढ़ने की दक्षता के बारे में चिंताएँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
